Kilasia Waterfalls in Marangu, Kilimanjaro is unique for its glacier-fed waters cascading from Mount Kilimanjaro’s peak. Nestled in lush Chagga farmland at 40 minutes from Moshi, the 1-hour hike passes banana and coffee plantations, rainforest, and valleys. Visitors can swim in cool pools, spot colobus monkeys and birds, and enjoy views of Kibo. It blends nature, Chagga culture, botanical gardens, and easy access, making it a peaceful escape with authentic village life and photography spots.
